title: Provider Docs Index
description: Repo-stored, machine-readable index mapping each external-provider feature to its docs URL plus drift-tracking fields. The contract that external-service-milestone Index tickets populate and the doc-drift automation reads. See docs/review/external-service-milestone-pattern.md.

providers.description: One entry per external provider, keyed by provider slug (e.g. github-actions, neon, fly, axiom).

milestone.description: The external-service milestone this provider belongs to.

last_indexed.description: Date the provider's docs were last indexed (YYYY-MM-DD).

features.description: Feature -> docs mapping. Keyed by a stable feature slug used by the installer/human-setup flows.

docs_url.description: Canonical provider documentation URL for this feature.

local_ref.description: Path to the in-repo recipe/reference for this feature (e.g. recipes/integrations/<provider>.md).

content_signature.description: Signature (e.g. sha256:...) of the indexed doc content, captured at index time. Drift detection compares the current doc against this.

last_verified.description: Date this feature's doc was last verified against content_signature (YYYY-MM-DD).
